name: Barbarian
startingEquipment: Greataxe or any martial melee weapon
Two handaxes or any simple weapon

features.name: Rage
features.description: In battle, you fight with primal ferocity. On your turn, you can enter a rage as a bonus action. While raging, you gain bonus damage on melee attacks using Strength, resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage, and advantage on Strength checks and saves. You can't cast spells while raging. Your rage lasts for 1 minute.

features.name: Unarmored Defense
features.description: While not wearing armor, your AC equals 10 + Dexterity modifier + Constitution modifier.

features.name: Reckless Attack
features.description: You can throw aside all concern for defense to attack with fierce desperation. When you make your first attack on your turn, you can decide to attack recklessly. Doing so gives you advantage on melee weapon attack rolls using Strength during this turn, but attack rolls against you have advantage until your next turn.

features.name: Danger Sense
features.description: You have advantage on Dexterity saving throws against effects you can see, such as traps and spells. To gain this benefit, you can't be blinded, deafened, or incapacitated.

features.name: Primal Path
features.description: Choose a path that shapes the nature of your rage: Path of the Berserker or Path of the Totem Warrior.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores by 1. You can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.name: Fast Movement
features.description: Your speed increases by 10 feet while you aren't wearing heavy armor.

features.name: Path Feature
features.description: You gain a feature from your Primal Path.

features.name: Feral Instinct
features.description: Your instincts are so honed that you have advantage on initiative rolls. Additionally, if you are surprised at the beginning of combat and aren't incapacitated, you can act normally on your first turn, but only if you enter your rage before doing anything else on that turn.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Brutal Critical (1 die)
features.description: You can roll one additional weapon damage die when determining the extra damage for a critical hit with a melee attack.

features.name: Path Feature
features.description: You gain a feature from your Primal Path.

features.name: Relentless Rage
features.description: Your rage can keep you fighting despite grievous wounds. If you drop to 0 hit points while raging and don't die outright, you can make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw. If you succeed, you drop to 1 hit point instead.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Brutal Critical (2 dice)
features.description: You can roll two additional weapon damage dice when determining the extra damage for a critical hit.

features.name: Path Feature
features.description: You gain a feature from your Primal Path.

features.name: Persistent Rage
features.description: Your rage is so fierce that it ends early only if you fall unconscious or if you choose to end it.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Brutal Critical (3 dice)
features.description: You can roll three additional weapon damage dice when determining the extra damage for a critical hit.

features.name: Indomitable Might
features.description: If your total for a Strength check is less than your Strength score, you can use that score in place of the total.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Primal Champion
features.description: You embody the power of the wilds. Your Strength and Constitution scores increase by 4. Your maximum for those scores is now 24.

name: Bard
startingEquipment: Rapier or longsword or any simple weapon
Lute or any other musical instrument

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: You have learned to untangle and reshape the fabric of reality. You know two cantrips and four 1st-level spells of your choice from the bard spell list.

features.name: Bardic Inspiration (d6)
features.description: You can inspire others through stirring words or music. As a bonus action, choose one creature other than yourself within 60 feet who can hear you. That creature gains one Bardic Inspiration die, a d6. Once within the next 10 minutes, the creature can roll the die and add the number rolled to one ability check, attack roll, or saving throw it makes.

features.name: Jack of All Trades
features.description: You can add half your proficiency bonus, rounded down, to any ability check you make that doesn't already include your proficiency bonus.

features.name: Song of Rest (d6)
features.description: You can use soothing music or oration to help revitalize your wounded allies during a short rest. If you or any friendly creatures who can hear your performance regain hit points at the end of the short rest, each of those creatures regains an extra 1d6 hit points.

features.name: Bard College
features.description: You delve into the advanced techniques of a bard college of your choice: the College of Lore or the College of Valor.

features.name: Expertise
features.description: Choose two of your skill proficiencies. Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses either of the chosen proficiencies.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Bardic Inspiration (d8)
features.description: Your Bardic Inspiration die becomes a d8.

features.name: Font of Inspiration
features.description: You regain all of your expended uses of Bardic Inspiration when you finish a short or long rest.

features.name: Countercharm
features.description: You gain the ability to use musical notes or words of power to disrupt mind-influencing effects. As an action, you can start a performance that lasts until the end of your next turn. During that time, you and any friendly creatures within 30 feet of you have advantage on saving throws against being frightened or charmed.

features.name: College Feature
features.description: You gain a feature from your Bard College.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Song of Rest (d8)
features.description: Your Song of Rest die becomes a d8.

features.name: Bardic Inspiration (d10)
features.description: Your Bardic Inspiration die becomes a d10.

features.name: Expertise
features.description: Choose two more of your skill proficiencies to gain expertise.

features.name: Magical Secrets
features.description: You have plundered magical knowledge from a wide spectrum of disciplines. Choose two spells from any class, including this one. The spells you choose must be of a level you can cast.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Song of Rest (d10)
features.description: Your Song of Rest die becomes a d10.

features.name: College Feature
features.description: You gain a feature from your Bard College.

features.name: Magical Secrets
features.description: Choose two more spells from any class.

features.name: Bardic Inspiration (d12)
features.description: Your Bardic Inspiration die becomes a d12.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Song of Rest (d12)
features.description: Your Song of Rest die becomes a d12.

features.name: Magical Secrets
features.description: Choose two more spells from any class.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Superior Inspiration
features.description: When you roll initiative and have no uses of Bardic Inspiration left, you regain one use.

name: Cleric
startingEquipment: Scale mail or leather armor or chain mail
Light crossbow and 20 bolts or any simple weapon

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: As a conduit for divine power, you can cast cleric spells. You know three cantrips and can prepare a number of cleric spells equal to your Wisdom modifier + your cleric level.

features.name: Divine Domain
features.description: Choose one domain related to your deity: Knowledge, Life, Light, Nature, Tempest, Trickery, or War.

features.name: Channel Divinity (1/rest)
features.description: You gain the ability to channel divine energy directly from your deity, using that energy to fuel magical effects. You start with two such effects: Turn Undead and an effect determined by your domain.

features.name: Turn Undead
features.description: As an action, you present your holy symbol and speak a prayer censuring the undead. Each undead that can see or hear you within 30 feet must make a Wisdom saving throw.

features.name: Domain Feature
features.description: You gain a feature from your Divine Domain.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Destroy Undead (CR 1/2)
features.description: When an undead fails its saving throw against your Turn Undead feature, it is instantly destroyed if its CR is at or below 1/2.

features.name: Channel Divinity (2/rest)
features.description: You can use your Channel Divinity twice between rests.

features.name: Domain Feature
features.description: You gain a feature from your Divine Domain.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Destroy Undead (CR 1)
features.description: Your Destroy Undead feature now affects undead of CR 1 or lower.

features.name: Divine Intervention
features.description: You can call on your deity to intervene on your behalf when your need is great. Describe the assistance you seek, and roll percentile dice. If you roll a number equal to or lower than your cleric level, your deity intervenes.

features.name: Destroy Undead (CR 2)
features.description: Your Destroy Undead feature now affects undead of CR 2 or lower.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Destroy Undead (CR 3)
features.description: Your Destroy Undead feature now affects undead of CR 3 or lower.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Destroy Undead (CR 4)
features.description: Your Destroy Undead feature now affects undead of CR 4 or lower.

features.name: Channel Divinity (3/rest)
features.description: You can use your Channel Divinity three times between rests.

features.name: Domain Feature
features.description: You gain a feature from your Divine Domain.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1.

features.name: Divine Intervention Improvement
features.description: Your call for divine intervention succeeds automatically, no roll required.
